title: Do LLMs Align Human Values Regarding Social Biases? Judging and Explaining Social Biases with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain age-related stereotypical bias in Q&A scenarios (BBQ dataset) and emulated realistic misconduct contexts (CrowS-Pairs dataset) by measuring the misalignment rate and model agreeability.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain disability-related stereotypical bias using Q&A and emulated scenarios from the BBQ and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain gender and gender identity stereotypical bias using text scenarios across the BBQ, BiasDPO, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs benchmark datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain nationality-related stereotypical bias using scenarios from the BBQ and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain physical appearance-related stereotypical bias using Q&A and emulated scenarios from the BBQ and CrowS-Pairs datasets.

Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain racial and ethnic stereotypical bias using contexts and scenarios across all four utilized benchmark datasets (BBQ, BiasDPO, StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs).
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain religious stereotypical bias using Q&A, conversational, and emulated scenarios across the BBQ, BiasDPO, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain sexual orientation-related stereotypical bias using scenarios from the BBQ and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain socioeconomic status (SES) related stereotypical bias using scenarios from the BBQ and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately judge and explain profession-related stereotypical bias using emulated misconduct scenarios from the StereoSet dataset.
